pristine.sourcePolicy: repo-authored React declaration probes against the pinned adapter public entry

adapted.sourcePolicy: one-for-one adapted probes after permitted transformations

permittedTransformations.rule: React probes import vendored upstream/package/src; Octane probes import the package public entry
Matching @ts-expect-error controls must reject the same invalid shapes on both sides

divergences.rule: Public adapter types keep framework-prefixed names on each side
